Assessment of BA.evidence_source: Considered a positive body image measure, the 13-item Body Appreciation Scale (BAS; Avalos, Tylka, & Wood-Barcalow, 2005) assesses individuals' acceptance of, favorable opinions toward, and respect for their bodies. Confirmatory factor analysis upheld the BAS-2's unidimensionality and invariance across sex and sample type. The instruments used to assess body appreciation for Study X are BAS and BAS-2.

section_summary.extract_value: This abstract details the development and psychometric validation of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2). Across three studies, involving college and online community samples totaling 820 women and 767 men, the BAS-2 demonstrated strong psychometric properties including unidimensionality, invariance across sex and sample type, internal consistency, test-retest reliability, and construct validity.
